title: commentary — heed

sentences.sentence: Commentary is by Tom Ferris.
sentences.translation: 由汤姆•费里斯现场解说。

sentences.sentence: She has taught her children impeccable manners.
sentences.translation: 她把她的孩子教育得举止十分得体。

sentences.sentence: a bar with impeccable service
sentences.translation: 服务无可挑剔的酒吧

sentences.sentence: It was their serenity which galled her most.
sentences.translation: 最让她恼怒的是他们的平静。

sentences.sentence: He thought of her serenity as a foil for his intemperance.
sentences.translation: 在他看来，她的平静反衬出了他的放纵。

sentences.sentence: He attacks your purity with lust, and he attacks your serenity with worry.
sentences.translation: 他攻击欲望你的纯度，他用焦虑攻击你的宁平静。

sentences.sentence: ...the ignominy of being fired.
sentences.translation: ...被开除的羞辱。

sentences.sentence: Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
sentences.translation: 放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

translations.translation: 未经证实的， 无事实根据的

sentences.sentence: unsubstantiated allegations of child abuse
sentences.translation: 未经证实的虐待儿童的指控

sentences.sentence: the innermost depths of the cave
sentences.translation: 山洞的最深处

translations.translation: 大肆宣传， 大吹大擂

sentences.sentence: The power of red wine to counteract high cholesterol has been ballyhooed in the press.
sentences.translation: 红酒中和高胆固醇的功效在媒体上被夸大了。

sentences.sentence: ...the much-ballyhooed new Star Wars film.
sentences.translation: ...该部受到大肆宣传的新《星球大战》电影。

phrases.translation: n. 约柜（藏于古犹太圣殿至圣所内、刻有十诫的两块石板）

sentences.sentence: ...the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
sentences.translation: …公民权利和政治权利国际公约。

sentences.sentence: Wedding guests quaffed champagne.
sentences.translation: 婚礼上宾客开怀畅饮香槟酒。

sentences.sentence: ...the leader of the now defunct Social Democratic Party.
sentences.translation: …现已不存在的社会民主党的领袖。

sentences.sentence: These chromatic stone carvings are all made from a whole piece of stone.
sentences.translation: 这些彩色石雕作品均为一块完整的石材雕刻而成。

sentences.sentence: As final touches, aimed to eliminate some "fake CG looks", we added to all the images some slight chromatic aberration, a very subtle vignette, a few glow and some flare effects on light source.
sentences.translation: 在最后的处理上，去除了一些“虚假的CG外表”，我们给所有图像增加了一些轻微的色差，只是给光源稍微增加一点图案、发光和一些光斑效果。

sentences.sentence: Betty adores her grandchildren.
sentences.translation: 贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

sentences.sentence: There were insuperable obstacles, and the plan was abandoned.
sentences.translation: 由于存在无法克服的障碍，计划被放弃了。

sentences.sentence: As usual, the hero was facing insuperable odds.
sentences.translation: 照例，男主角遇到了无法克服的困难。

sentences.sentence: The sibyl prophesied victory.
sentences.translation: 女预言家预言胜利。

sentences.sentence: The sibyl ("witch" is such an uncouth label) responded with a supply constriction designed to drive up the price.
sentences.translation: 女预言家（“女巫”听上去让人不太舒服）则用限制供应的方法来应对，意在推升价格。

sentences.sentence: View your job, and her job, as a shared accountability.
sentences.translation: 把你和她的工作看做是一种联合责任。

sentences.sentence: But you must balance that need with the need for accountability.
sentences.translation: 但是你必须在个人需求和责任感两方面做出平衡。

sentences.sentence: Some of us have trouble with accountability because we associate the word with punishment, scrutiny, and/or not meeting standards or agreements.
sentences.translation: 好些人都把责任理解错误了，因为我们总是把责任和惩罚，仔细检查或者没有达到标准或不一致性联系在一起。

phrases.translation: 皮尔斯·布鲁斯南（美国电影演员）

sentences.sentence: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
sentences.translation: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

sentences.sentence: Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
sentences.translation: 罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

sentences.translation: 要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 432 单元

commentary
音标：英 /'kɑːmənteri/  美 /'kɑməntɛri/
n.  实况报道； 集注
短语：commentary on — 对……的评论
短语：running commentary — 当场连续评述
例句：Commentary is by Tom Ferris.
由汤姆•费里斯现场解说。

impeccable
音标：英 /ɪm'pekəbl/  美 /ɪm'pɛkəbl/
adj.  无瑕疵的
例句：She has taught her children impeccable manners.
她把她的孩子教育得举止十分得体。
例句：a bar with impeccable service
服务无可挑剔的酒吧

serenity
音标：英 /sə'renəti/  美 /si'renəti/
n.  平静
例句：It was their serenity which galled her most.
最让她恼怒的是他们的平静。
例句：He thought of her serenity as a foil for his intemperance.
在他看来，她的平静反衬出了他的放纵。
例句：He attacks your purity with lust, and he attacks your serenity with worry.
他攻击欲望你的纯度，他用焦虑攻击你的宁平静。

ignominy
音标：英 /'ɪgnəmɪni/  美 /'ɪɡnəmɪni/
n.  羞耻， 耻辱
例句：...the ignominy of being fired.
...被开除的羞辱。

seep
音标：英 /siːp/  美 /sip/
v.  渗漏
短语：seep into — 渗入；影响到；流入
例句：Radioactive water had seeped into underground reservoirs.
放射性水已渗入了地下蓄水池。

unsubstantiated
音标：英 /ˌʌnsəb'stænʃieɪtɪd/  美 /,ʌnsəb'stænʃɪetɪd/
adj.  未经证实的， 无事实根据的
例句：unsubstantiated allegations of child abuse
未经证实的虐待儿童的指控

innermost
音标：英 /'ɪnərmoust/  美 /'ɪnɚmost/
adj.  最里面的
例句：the innermost depths of the cave
山洞的最深处

ballyhoo
音标：英 /'bælihuː/  美 /'bælɪhu/
v.  大肆宣传， 大吹大擂
n. 喧闹，呐喊
例句：The power of red wine to counteract high cholesterol has been ballyhooed in the press.
红酒中和高胆固醇的功效在媒体上被夸大了。
例句：...the much-ballyhooed new Star Wars film.
...该部受到大肆宣传的新《星球大战》电影。

covenant
音标：英 /'kʌvənənt/  美 /'kʌvənənt/
v.  立书保证
n. 契约
短语：ark of the covenant — n. 约柜（藏于古犹太圣殿至圣所内、刻有十诫的两块石板）
例句：...the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.
…公民权利和政治权利国际公约。

quaff
音标：英 /kwɑːf/  美 /kwæf/
v.  痛饮， 畅饮
例句：Wedding guests quaffed champagne.
婚礼上宾客开怀畅饮香槟酒。

defunct
音标：英 /dɪ'fʌŋkt/  美 /dɪ'fʌŋkt/
adj.  死亡的
例句：...the leader of the now defunct Social Democratic Party.
…现已不存在的社会民主党的领袖。

chromatic
音标：英 /krə'mætɪk/  美 /krə'mætɪk/
adj.  彩色的， 五彩的
短语：chromatic aberration — n. 色差；像差
短语：chromatic dispersion — [医]色散
短语：chromatic scale — 半音音阶
例句：These chromatic stone carvings are all made from a whole piece of stone.
这些彩色石雕作品均为一块完整的石材雕刻而成。
例句：As final touches, aimed to eliminate some "fake CG looks", we added to all the images some slight chromatic aberration, a very subtle vignette, a few glow and some flare effects on light source.
在最后的处理上，去除了一些“虚假的CG外表”，我们给所有图像增加了一些轻微的色差，只是给光源稍微增加一点图案、发光和一些光斑效果。

adore
音标：英 /ə'dɔːr/  美 /ə'dɔr/
v.  崇拜； 爱慕
例句：Betty adores her grandchildren.
贝蒂非常宠爱孙辈。

insuperable
音标：英 /ɪn'suːpərəbl/  美 /ɪn'supərəbl/
adj.  难以克服的
例句：There were insuperable obstacles, and the plan was abandoned.
由于存在无法克服的障碍，计划被放弃了。
例句：As usual, the hero was facing insuperable odds.
照例，男主角遇到了无法克服的困难。

sibyl
音标：英 /'sɪbl/  美 /'sɪbl/
n.  女预言家， 女先知
例句：The sibyl prophesied victory.
女预言家预言胜利。
例句：The sibyl ("witch" is such an uncouth label) responded with a supply constriction designed to drive up the price.
女预言家（“女巫”听上去让人不太舒服）则用限制供应的方法来应对，意在推升价格。

accountability
音标：英 /əˌkauntə'bɪləti/  美 /ə,kaʊntə'bɪləti/
n.  有责任
短语：accountability system — 问责制；责任追究制度
例句：View your job, and her job, as a shared accountability.
把你和她的工作看做是一种联合责任。
例句：But you must balance that need with the need for accountability.
但是你必须在个人需求和责任感两方面做出平衡。
例句：Some of us have trouble with accountability because we associate the word with punishment, scrutiny, and/or not meeting standards or agreements.
好些人都把责任理解错误了，因为我们总是把责任和惩罚，仔细检查或者没有达到标准或不一致性联系在一起。

pierce
音标：英 /pɪrs/  美 /pɪrs/
v.  刺穿； 穿透
短语：pierce through — 突破，穿刺入
短语：pierce brosnan — 皮尔斯·布鲁斯南（美国电影演员）
例句：Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。
例句：Rose underwent emergency surgery after a bullet pierced her lung.
罗丝被子弹射穿肺部，接受了紧急手术。

underbid
音标：英 /ˌʌndər'bɪd/  美 /,ʌndɚ'bɪd/
v.  叫价低于； 要价过低
例句：Irena underbid the other dealers.

closet
音标：英 /'klɑːzət/  美 /'klɑzət/
adj. 秘密的
n.  壁橱
短语：water closet — 厕所；抽水马桶
例句：a closet full of beautiful clothes
满是漂亮衣服的壁橱

heed
音标：英 /hiːd/  美 /hid/
v. 注意，留心
n.  注意， 留心
例句：If she had only heeded my warnings , none of this would have happened.
要是她当初听从我的警告，这一切都不会发生。
